svg.title: TurtlePen connection history

g.aria-label: text turtlepen-history__title: TurtlePen connection history
box turtlepen-history__original-prototype__card: August 29, 2026 Original hosted prototype The first hosted connector exposed five stateless TurtlePen tools. complete
g.text: The first hosted connector exposed five

g.aria-label: box turtlepen-history__canonical-engine__card: Later that day Canonical stateful engine The hosted route adopted the full stateful TurtlePen tool inventory. complete
g.text: The hosted route adopted the full stateful

g.aria-label: box turtlepen-history__stale-beta-connector__card: After the engine upgrade Installed beta connector stayed stale ChatGPT retained the original five-tool schema instead of rediscovering the canonical inventory. delayed
g.text: ChatGPT retained the original five-tool schema

g.aria-label: box turtlepen-history__unsupported-sites-key__card: Before restoration Sites declaration removed An unsupported discovery key was removed rather than left as a misleading capability claim.
g.text: An unsupported discovery key was removed rather
than left as a misleading capability claim.

g.aria-label: box turtlepen-history__capability-restored__card: September 3, 2026 Supported MCP capability published Brainn.dev declared the supported Sites MCP capability and restored native discovery. complete
g.text: Brainn.dev declared the supported Sites MCP

g.aria-label: box turtlepen-history__account-feature-setting__card: Current Account setting still controls access Native Sites MCP availability remains controlled by the user account feature setting. current
g.text: Native Sites MCP availability remains controlled
by the user account feature setting.
